source: Baumler et al., J. Appl. Phys. 126, 045715 (2019), Fig. n/k; digitized by digitize_baumler.py (k resolution ~0.008; k=0 below 3.5 eV)
model: eps = eps_inf + sum_j B_j lam^2/(lam^2 - lam_j^2 - 1j*g_j*(lam_j/lam)**P*lam); n+ik = sqrt(eps); lam in um
note: k beyond transparent_nm is fitted to 0: the digitized data cannot resolve k < ~0.01, so pump-band absorption must come from waveguide-loss data, not this fit.
